data.long_meaning: Jawdah is an Arabic name that means generous or liberal. It is unisex and commonly used in Islamic communities. The name Jawdah carries the meaning “Generous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Parents who choose Jawdah usually hope their child will grow to embody generous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
